description: This file sets up Express routes for managing 'labs' resources in an API, including listing, retrieving details, hints, submission, creation, update, and deletion. It uses controllers and middleware for authorization.

methods.name: listLabs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all published labs.

methods.name: getLab
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific lab by ID.

methods.name: getHints
methods.description: Handles GET requests to obtain ordered hints for a specific lab.

methods.name: submitSolution
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a solution attempt for a lab, includes authentication middleware.

methods.name: createLab
methods.description: Handles POST requests for admins to create a new lab, includes authentication and admin authorization middleware.

methods.name: updateLab
methods.description: Handles PUT requests for admins to update a lab by ID, with authentication and admin middleware.

methods.name: deleteLab
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests for admins to delete a lab by ID, with authentication and admin middleware.
